message:
feat(standby): a durable generation store, one HelloAck test for both handshakes (keepalive-r2 2 r3, N1 N3)

N3: FileGenerationStore saves by write -> flush to the device -> checked close -> atomic replace (MoveFileExW
REPLACE_EXISTING|WRITE_THROUGH / rename + directory fsync), and says true only after all of them; any failure = nothing
sent under that generation. One writer (an exclusive <path>.lock), UTF-8 paths opened as UTF-16 on Windows, a damaged
file = a new device id. Test: a non-ASCII directory under REMOTE60_TEST_TMP, a second store refused, each Save step
failing by injection (no crash on this PC) then a reopen oracle (same id, next generation above every one sent).

N1: udp_hello_ack_acceptable is the ordinary handshake's ack test, extracted unchanged; the standby activation uses it
too (DirectoryAuth required) plus the declared size. Entry client: A cancelled -> B -> A's late HelloAck and Pong ->
only B's own Pong activates B.

standby_entry_client_test 72/72.
